# version label

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:versionLabel`](gmeow-versionLabel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/versionLabel>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)

The version designation of an entity as a literal ("1993", "2011", "v2.1.0-beta", "3rd Edition"). Domain is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) so any versioned artifact — a language, a software release, a book edition, a dataset, an email variant — may carry its designation. Non-functional.
